summary: After officials struggle to reach one another, {person} sends a crew to give them a dedicated phone line.
realLife: Jimmy Carter offered White House communications staff after learning about the difficulty of getting calls through.
gates: Response officials report difficulty reaching one another and communications help is available.
weights: More failed calls on a decision deadline favor dispatching a crew.
inGame: needs: communications support requested and restored.

turns.what: The local communications office restores the connection itself.
turns.pulledBy: A local technician is available before the federal crew can leave.
turns.writesBack: The service log closes the request with the local repair.

turns.what: The governor's office gets a working line while the field team still needs one.
turns.pulledBy: The first connection reaches headquarters only.
turns.writesBack: The support request remains open for the field location.
